claims.name: slug-behaves
claims.risk: slug is missing or wrong on a title with punctuation, repeated spaces, digits, an existing dash or no letters

claims.name: only-the-helper-and-its-test-changed
claims.risk: a pure helper grew a change to the service, another file, a saved artifact or a commit

claims.name: no-service-started-for-a-pure-helper
claims.risk: the service was started or a URL requested for a helper that the service never calls, or the answer reports the running service UNVERIFIED
